scope: Bound single-role file export and reject results after workspace closure
behavior: Role backup encryption has a three-minute deadline inside the workspace operation lock. Expiry releases the lock and retains password/confirmation for explicit retry.
The export captures a workspace lifetime counter, checks it after encryption and again before downloading. Late results cannot download or mark the workspace backed up.
The encrypted snapshot and existing validation are unchanged. WebCrypto itself is not cancelled.

unit.scope: New unmount and timeout-during-explicit-retry cases plus the complete RoleWorkspace component suite.

browser.scope: Desktop/mobile hold the first real PBKDF2 result past virtual expiry, observe zero late downloads and exactly one after explicit retry. Existing role-draft file/browser recovery also passes.

release.scope: Normal web build/typecheck and release manifest after browser tests.

limits: Browser expiry is simulated with a virtual clock and delayed key result, not physical suspend.
No full regression, runtime-image refresh, native wallet signing or public deployment.
Other role operations, including browser-copy unlocking, are separate from this export deadline.
